summary: Iteration 8 (restructured student payments + auto-log income tx + agent ledger + Recharts overlay suppression) tested end-to-end. BACKEND: 9/9 new iteration-8 tests pass in 2.2s (test_iteration8.py). Verified: (1) POST /api/students/{id}/payments with new shape persists received_in object + has_adjustment + adjustments[] with auto-generated adjustment ids; (2) auto-logged income tx created with linked_student_id + linked_student_payment_id when received_in.account_id is set, with correct fee_type→category mapping (booking_admission→Admission Fees, tution→Tution Fees, other→Other Fees); (3) PATCH payment re-syncs linked tx (delete+recreate); (4) DELETE payment removes linked tx; (5) DELETE student cascade-deletes all tx where linked_student_id matches; (6) NO tx created when received_in.account_id is missing and type != 'cash'; (7) Legacy payments (route/sub_agent_* fields) normalized into received_in/adjustments on read for both /api/students list and /api/students/{id}; (8) GET /api/students/agent-ledger returns aggregated rows per (type, name), holding = received - paid_to_college - sc_adjusted; (9) Canonical Rohan Mehta totals match exactly: $40,000 received / $10,000 paid_to_college / $15,000 sc_adjusted / $15,000 holding. FRONTEND (live preview Playwright on https://budget-buddy-5001.preview.emergentagent.com): logged in admin@finflow.com; nav-agents sidebar link visible (label 'Sub-agents'); /agents page renders agents-page testid, agent-totals tile (Routed 41,500 / Paid to college 10,000 / SC Adjusted 15,000 / Holding 16,500) and 2 agent rows incl. agent-row-sub_agent-Rohan-Mehta with exact canonical totals visible in the UI. Student detail for Aarav Sharma shows 3 payment rows with new 'Received in' chip (College Acc / Sub Agent Acc + Rohan Mehta name beneath). The structured $25k payment row has pay-expand toggle that, when clicked, reveals adjustment breakdown (Paid to College ₹10k on May 15 Bank Transfer · Bank to college / SC Adjusted ₹15k Cash · with Sub Agent Rohan Mehta · SC commission). Aarav Sharma totals correctly summed to Collected ₹50,000 and Balance vs SC ₹25,000. 'Log payment' dialog fields all present: pay-date, pay-schedule, pay-fee-type (Booking/Admission Fees default), pay-amount, pay-recv-type (College Acc default), pay-recv-name (hidden for college as expected), pay-recv-account, pay-has-adjustment, pay-remarks. Toggling pay-has-adjustment reveals adjustments-block + adj-add; clicking adj-add creates row with adj-kind-0/adj-amount-0/adj-date-0/adj-mode-0 and live adj-balance counter. Auto-logged income tx 'Student fee — Aarav Sharma · Admission Fees · 1st installment via Rohan' visible in /transactions ledger with Admission Fees category and ₹25,000 income on Main Bank. RECHARTS overlay: dashboard loads with width(-1)/height(-1) chart warnings in console but NO red CRA dev error overlay paints (suppression in index.js works). After viewport resize bounce (1200→1500→1800px), no overlay and nav remains clickable (navigated to /transactions successfully). All iteration-8 acceptance criteria pass.
action_items: (Cleanup, low priority) /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py has 5 failures caused by iteration-8's payment-schema restructure (it still uses route/sub_agent_type/sub_agent_name and asserts Aarav Sharma collected_total==25000 — now 50000 after the 3rd structured payment was seeded). These are STALE assertions, not iteration-8 regressions. Either delete test_iteration7.py (superseded by test_iteration8.py) or update it to the new received_in shape and the new $50k Aarav total. test_iteration3.py also still has 1 stale failure carried from iteration 7 (seed campus_visit invoice student_name removed).

(Cleanup, optional) The /agents page shows a leftover TestAgent row (₹1,500 routed, ₹1,500 holding) from previous iteration-7 UI testing. Not a bug — just test data that survived in the seeded admin's student doc. Main agent may wish to scrub it if the demo data should be canonical.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/students.py is well-scoped (~390 lines). New PaymentItemIn uses ReceivedIn sub-model + Adjustment sub-model with Literal-typed enums — Pydantic gives free 422 on invalid kind/type. Good.

_normalize_legacy_payment is read-only and idempotent; if 'received_in' already exists, it ensures defaults for has_adjustment/adjustments/fee_type and returns. Migration is non-destructive — verified that legacy Aarav payments coexist with new structured payments in the same array.

_auto_log_payment_transaction is delete-then-insert on every save (idempotent via linked_student_payment_id index). PATCH path re-fetches the updated payment from the freshly-read student doc to use the latest amount/account/fee_type — correct.

_auto_log_payment_transaction has a sensible fallback: if account_id is missing AND received_in.type == 'cash', it auto-picks the user's first cash account. Otherwise no tx is created. Confirmed in test_no_tx_when_no_account_and_not_cash.
DELETE student now cascade-deletes db.transactions where linked_student_id == student_id — verified end-to-end in test_delete_student_cascades_tx.
server.py adds indices on transactions.linked_student_id and transactions.linked_student_payment_id (per spec). Both used in the cascade-delete and tx-resync paths.
Agent ledger endpoint: O(N) over students, deduplicates students via a Python set (later JSON-serialized as list). Holding math is right. Rows sorted desc by total_received. Clean.

Pydantic does NOT enforce 'name is required when type in {sub_agent, associate, km}' — backend persists name=None for sub_agent type if client omits it. The ledger then groups it under name='—'. Frontend correctly guards this with a name input when type is non-college/non-cash/non-bank, but a server-side model_validator would harden the API. Non-blocking.
Pydantic does NOT enforce 'sub_agent_type+sub_agent_name required when adjustment.kind=sc_adjusted'. Same comment — frontend guards it, backend doesn't reject. Non-blocking.

Agents.jsx is tidy (~115 lines). Uses TYPE_META map for icons/colors. data-testid='agent-row-{type}-{name-slug}' uses /\W+/g→'-' which is fine for canonical names but collisions are possible if two agents have names that differ only by punctuation — unlikely in practice.

StudentDetail.jsx Log Payment dialog correctly hides pay-recv-name field when type is college|cash|bank (only visible for sub_agent|associate|km). The adj-sub-type / adj-sub-name fields conditionally render only when kind=sc_adjusted. adj-balance live total works.

index.js ResizeObserver suppression is correctly scoped (only swallows the two known message strings) and uses both 'error' and 'unhandledrejection' listeners with stopImmediatePropagation+preventDefault — this prevents the CRA react-error-overlay iframe from painting. Verified in browser: no overlay even after multi-resize bounce. Production builds don't include the overlay so this is dev-only ergonomics.

Minor: chart still emits 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warnings on first render — root cause is the Recharts ResponsiveContainer measuring before layout settles. Functional behavior is unaffected, but a minHeight on the chart container would silence the warning entirely.

rca of the issue: 5 iteration-7 test failures (test_patch_student_preserves_embedded, test_payment_routes_college_cash_subagent, test_payment_update_and_delete, test_payment_schedule_link, test_seeded_aarav_sharma_totals) are STALE — they assert against the old PaymentItem schema (top-level route/sub_agent_type/sub_agent_name fields) and the old Aarav seeded total ($25k). Iteration 8 replaced that schema with received_in{} + adjustments[] and added a 3rd $25k structured payment to Aarav (raising total to $50k). Errors are 422 from Pydantic rejecting old payload + KeyError 'payments' (request never reached the embedded-array stage). Repro: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py. Mitigation: delete test_iteration7.py (replaced by test_iteration8.py) OR rewrite each test using ReceivedIn shape + new $50k Aarav assertion.
